## Parts

- [Partial] Performance Clutch Kit: Options include metallic, Jim Wolf or organic; consider upgrading flywheel if using a high-performance kit. [t876]
- [Partial] Upgraded Flywheel: Recommended when pairing with higher bite clutches to handle increased power transfer. [t876]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Consider metallic clutch material over organic if running larger tires and a suspension lift. [t876]
- Note that performance clutches offer more 'bite' which helps control climbs but may require an upgraded master cylinder (specifically for Spec Stage 2). [t876]
